Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the answer as "B) the nervous system" based on a flawed understanding of biological functions. While the nervous system controls the brain, the physical protection against bumps (trauma) is provided by the skull, which is part of the skeletal system. The Planner failed to distinguish between the functional role of the nervous system and the structural protective role of the skeletal system, leading to the wrong conclusion immediately.
